title: Not impressed, binned half
text: The box overpromised and overcharged for what it offers. March 2023 box was supposed to contain "8 products" and it indeed contained. One of those 8 products was some sort of small cookie or biscuit. Another product was very basic plastic keychain with an inspirational phrase. Blush in a colour I'd never use. Temporary tattoo package. Half of the products I am planning to use and didn't end up in the bin like the ones I listed before, but it was definitely not worth the price tag it have.
label: negative
